# DRAFT ordinary proof for MathDB 365710

Zero accepted credit. This current presentation extracts the complete argument from the frozen historical candidate. Its historical status text is preserved only in sources/. Zhou 2004, Theorem 5 and Eq.1, already supplies the deficit identity; no novelty is claimed for it. The manuscript gives the actual Lean walk/twin structural proof.

## Endpoint

For every finite simple connected triangle-free graph G with n >= 2 vertices,

    sigma_t(G) <= max_{1 <= a <= n-1} a(n-a)(n-2a)^2.

Every maximum is achieved by a complete bipartite graph. In fact any maximizing graph is complete bipartite. The n = 1 case has value zero. This settles the full extremal assertion in the MathDB record in ordinary mathematics, subject to independent review. It does not identify which of the two source Proposition 11 rounded part sizes wins; the finite maximum formulation already matches Conjecture 24.

Write m = |E(G)|, M = sum_v d(v)^2, and D = nm - M. Expanding the sum over unordered vertex pairs gives

    sigma_t(G) = nM - 4m^2 = m(n^2 - 4m) - nD.                  (1)

The handshake identity sum_v d(v) = 2m proves the first equality. Also M = sum_{uv in E}(d(u)+d(v)). For each edge uv of a triangle-free graph, N(u) and N(v) are disjoint, so the number of vertices adjacent to neither endpoint is n-d(u)-d(v). Consequently D is exactly the number of three-element vertex sets inducing precisely one edge. In particular D >= 0.

## Gap lemma

If a connected triangle-free graph on n vertices is not complete bipartite, then

    D >= n-2.                                                 (2)

First such a graph contains an induced P4. Here is a proof avoiding an imported cograph characterization. If there is no induced P4, fix v and set A=N(v), B=V\A. Every shortest path is induced, so every vertex of B other than v has distance two from v. Given b in B\{v}, choose a in A adjacent to b. For any a' in A not adjacent to b, b,a,v,a' would be an induced P4: A is independent by triangle-freeness and b is not adjacent to v. Thus b is adjacent to every element of A. Since G is connected and n >= 2, A is nonempty. Any edge within B would now make a triangle with any a in A. Thus A and B are independent and all cross edges exist, a contradiction.

Fix an induced path a-b-c-d. It has exactly two induced one-edge triples, namely {a,b,d} and {a,c,d}. Every vertex x outside this path contributes at least one further such triple using x and two path vertices. To prove this, suppose it contributes none. The neighbors S of x in the path are independent, since otherwise there is a triangle. Also S meets every path edge, since an edge with neither endpoint in S would itself give a one-edge triple with x. An independent vertex cover of the connected path is one of its two bipartition classes, {a,c} or {b,d}. In either case {x,a,d} induces exactly one edge (a and d are not adjacent and exactly one is in S), contradiction. The selected triples for distinct x are distinct and none lies wholly in the fixed path. This proves (2). No extension induction or probabilistic assumption is involved.

## Integer bracketing

For n >= 7, there is an integer 1 <= a <= n-1 with

    a(n-a)(n-2a)^2 >= n^4/16 - (n-3)^2.                       (3)

Set h(t)=t(n-t), 1 <= t <= floor(n/2). These values increase. The first value n-1 is at most n^2/8 for n >= 7: n^2-8n+8 is 1 at 7 and increases thereafter. The last value floor(n^2/4) is at least n^2/8. Thus either one value equals n^2/8, or two consecutive values bracket it. For consecutive parameters t and t+1, with t >= 1, the gap is n-2t-1 <= n-3. At least one endpoint of a bracketing interval is within half its length of n^2/8. For this endpoint a,

    |h(a)-n^2/8| <= (n-3)/2.

Now use the exact polynomial identity

    h(a)(n^2-4h(a)) = n^4/16 - 4(h(a)-n^2/8)^2,

and n^2-4a(n-a)=(n-2a)^2. This proves (3). It uses rational arithmetic only, with no square roots or continuous optimization assumption.

## Conclusion

Let G be connected, triangle-free and not complete bipartite. Necessarily n >= 4. For n >= 7, equations (1) and (2) imply

    sigma_t(G) <= n^4/16 - n(n-2)
               < n^4/16 - (n-3)^2
               <= max_{1 <= a <= n-1} a(n-a)(n-2a)^2,

where the strict inequality is n(n-2)-(n-3)^2=4n-9>0. The first bound follows by completing the square in m. For n = 4,5,6 the same upper bound is respectively 8, 385/16, 57, strictly smaller than the star values 12,36,80. For n <= 3, every connected triangle-free graph is complete bipartite (or the singleton). Finally K_{a,n-a} is connected and triangle-free for 1 <= a <= n-1 and its irregularity is exactly a(n-a)(n-2a)^2. This proves the endpoint and the stronger maximizing-graph characterization.

# Portable strict replay (DRAFT; zero credit)

Prerequisites: Linux, Python 3, Lean 4.34.1 (commit 5045d0056413266e57c625dcd7c365b10e377c52), and the pinned mathlib/package cache in pins.json. No network, Lake invocation or cache writes are performed. The supplied objects are trusted upstream dependencies, not bundled here. Binary and Mathlib.olean hashes must match pins.json. LEAN_PACKAGES denotes the directory containing mathlib and its sibling packages; LEAN_BIN contains lean and leanchecker.

From a directory in which you may create a new extraction:

```sh
python3 safe_extract.py source-only-proof.zip fresh
cd fresh
export LEAN_BIN=/path/to/lean-4.34.1-linux/bin
export LEAN_PACKAGES=/path/to/pinned/.lake/packages
python3 replay.py
```

Use a fresh extraction each time: replay refuses all existing oleans and existing replay receipts. It verifies source-manifest.json, builds in dependency order with `-j1 -DwarningAsError=true`, checks each module with leanchecker, inventories every generated/local declaration, and runs three expected elaboration failures. Receipts appear in replay-receipts; result.json must say PASS. The three failures test only the displayed mutations: ordered-factor confusion, using a non-induced path, and dropping triangle-freeness. They are not exhaustive mutation testing.

All subprocesses use at most two affinity CPUs, CPU 120 s, wall 140 s, AS 64 GiB, MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=2 and a sampled 6 GiB RssAnon+RssShmem guard. Total VmRSS is reported separately. A probed systemd user scope applies MemoryMax=6G when available. No driver deletes anything outside its fresh extraction; only its temporary rejected-mutation file is removed. Do not run against the original frozen packet. No upstream cache is modified.

The 12 frozen mathematical/control modules are 11 Sigma modules plus NegativeControls. The inspection drivers and reviewer supplements are separately labeled. The body audit permits only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound, and demands actual bodies, safe and nonpartial declarations. See declarations.json and original audit logs for full types and transitive axioms.

Manuscript regeneration uses write_paper.py (Python reportlab and DejaVu Serif fonts); paper-content.json contains the prose. Render with pdftoppm. The source-only ZIP omits PDF, rendered images, replay objects and receipts; the full dossier includes the final PDF, visual QA and completed replay receipts but excludes compiled objects/caches. Hash manifests are integrity bindings, not digital signatures or independent proofs. Frozen-before/after inventories bind every regular file in all six designated inputs; some initial orientation reads preceded the baseline, explicitly disclosed in SUMMARY.md.

namespace Sigma365710
open Finset

theorem left_card {n a : ℕ} (ha : a < n) :
    (univ.filter (fun v : Fin n => v.val < a)).card = a := by
  have heq : univ.filter (fun v : Fin n => v.val < a) = Iio (⟨a, ha⟩ : Fin n) := by
    ext v; simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, mem_Iio]; rfl
  rw [heq, Fin.card_Iio]

theorem completeBipartite_degree {n a : ℕ} (ha : a < n) (u : Fin n) :
    (completeBipartite n a).degree u = if u.val < a then n - a else a := by
  rw [← SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
  have hleft := left_card ha
  by_cases hu : u.val < a
  · simp only [hu, ↓reduceIte]
    have heq : (completeBipartite n a).neighborFinset u =
        univ \ univ.filter (fun v : Fin n => v.val < a) := by
      ext v
      rw [SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset]
      simp [completeBipartite, hu]
    rw [heq, card_sdiff_of_subset (subset_univ _), card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, hleft]
  · simp only [hu, ↓reduceIte]
    have heq : (completeBipartite n a).neighborFinset u =
        univ.filter (fun v : Fin n => v.val < a) := by
      ext v
      rw [SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset]
      simp [completeBipartite, hu]
      omega
    rw [heq, hleft]

theorem sum_partition {n a : ℕ} (ha : a < n) (x y : ℤ) :
    (∑ u : Fin n, if u.val < a then x else y) = (a : ℤ) * x + ((n : ℤ) - a) * y := by
  have h := sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not (s := (univ : Finset (Fin n)))
    (p := fun u => u.val < a) (f := fun u => if u.val < a then x else y)
  have hl := left_card ha
  have hr : (univ.filter (fun u : Fin n => ¬ u.val < a)).card = n - a := by
    have hh := card_filter_add_card_filter_not (p := fun u : Fin n => u.val < a) (s := univ)
    simp only [card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at hh
    omega
  have hx : (∑ u ∈ univ.filter (fun u : Fin n => u.val < a),
      if u.val < a then x else y) = (a : ℤ) * x := by
    have heq : (∑ u ∈ univ.filter (fun u : Fin n => u.val < a),
        if u.val < a then x else y) = ∑ _u ∈ univ.filter (fun u : Fin n => u.val < a), x := by
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro u hu
      simp only [(mem_filter.mp hu).2, ↓reduceIte]
    rw [heq, sum_const, hl, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hy : (∑ u ∈ univ.filter (fun u : Fin n => ¬ u.val < a),
      if u.val < a then x else y) = ((n : ℤ) - a) * y := by
    have heq : (∑ u ∈ univ.filter (fun u : Fin n => ¬ u.val < a),
        if u.val < a then x else y) = ∑ _u ∈ univ.filter (fun u : Fin n => ¬ u.val < a), y := by
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro u hu
      simp only [(mem_filter.mp hu).2, ↓reduceIte]
    rw [heq, sum_const, hr, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_sub (by omega : a ≤ n)]
  rw [← h, hx, hy]

    sigmaT (completeBipartite n a) = F n a := by
  rw [sigmaT, pair_variance]
  simp_rw [completeBipartite_degree ha]
  push_cast

  rw [sum_partition ha, sum_partition ha]
  rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : a ≤ n)]
  unfold F
  ring

The universal triangle-free domination theorem is proved in Sigma.Endpoint. -/

    ∃ a : ℕ, 1 ≤ a ∧ a < n ∧

  symm := ⟨by intros; tauto⟩
  loopless := ⟨by intro; simp⟩

  change ((_ ∧ _) ∨ (_ ∧ _)) at huv huw hvw
  tauto

      omega
    have htv : (completeBipartite n a).Adj t v := by

      exact Or.inr ⟨Nat.lt_irrefl _, hv⟩

    change (0 < a ∧ ¬v.val < a) ∨ (¬0 < a ∧ v.val < a)
    exact Or.inl ⟨by omega, hv⟩

theorem pair_variance {n : ℕ} (d : Fin n → ℤ) :
    (∑ u : Fin n, ∑ v ∈ univ.filter (u < ·), (d u - d v)^2) =
    (n : ℤ) * ∑ u, d u ^ 2 - (∑ u, d u)^2 := by

  have hdouble : (∑ u : Fin n, ∑ v : Fin n, (d u - d v)^2) = U + U := by
    have hsplit : ∀ u v : Fin n, (d u - d v)^2 =
        (if u < v then (d u - d v)^2 else 0) +
        (if v < u then (d u - d v)^2 else 0) := by
      intro u v
      rcases lt_trichotomy u v with h | h | h
      · simp [h, not_lt_of_ge h.le]
      · subst v; simp
      · simp [h, not_lt_of_ge h.le]
    calc
      _ = ∑ u : Fin n, ∑ v : Fin n,
          ((if u < v then (d u - d v)^2 else 0) +
          (if v < u then (d u - d v)^2 else 0)) := by
        apply sum_congr rfl; intro u _
        apply sum_congr rfl; intro v _
        exact hsplit u v
      _ = _ := by
        simp only [sum_add_distrib]
        dsimp [U]
        simp only [sum_filter]
        congr 1
        rw [sum_comm]
        apply sum_congr rfl
        intro u _
        apply sum_congr rfl
        intro v _
        split_ifs <;> ring

  have hexpand : (∑ u : Fin n, ∑ v : Fin n, (d u - d v)^2) =
      2 * ((n : ℤ) * ∑ u, d u ^ 2 - (∑ u, d u)^2) := by

    simp_rw [← mul_sum, ← sum_mul]

def OneEdgeTriple {V : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph V) (x y z : V) : Prop :=

/-- Four distinct vertices whose induced graph is a path, in path order. -/
def InducedP4 {V : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph V) (a b c d : V) : Prop :=
  a ≠ b ∧ a ≠ c ∧ a ≠ d ∧ b ≠ c ∧ b ≠ d ∧ c ≠ d ∧
  G.Adj a b ∧ G.Adj b c ∧ G.Adj c d ∧
  ¬ G.Adj a c ∧ ¬ G.Adj a d ∧ ¬ G.Adj b d

/-- Literal complementary independent parts with all cross edges. -/
def HasCompleteBipartition {V : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph V) : Prop :=
  ∃ S : Set V, ∀ u v, G.Adj u v ↔ (u ∈ S ∧ v ∉ S) ∨ (u ∉ S ∧ v ∈ S)

theorem two_step_twins {V : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph V) (hG : G.CliqueFree 3)
    (hp : ¬ ∃ a b c d, InducedP4 G a b c d)
    {u v w : V} (huv : G.Adj u v) (hvw : G.Adj v w) :
    ∀ x, G.Adj u x ↔ G.Adj w x := by
  classical
  have one : ∀ {u v w x : V}, G.Adj u v → G.Adj v w → G.Adj u x → G.Adj w x := by
    intro u v w x huv hvw hux
    by_contra hwx
    have huw : ¬ G.Adj u w := fun h => no_triangle G hG huv h hvw
    have hvx : ¬ G.Adj v x := fun h => no_triangle G hG huv hux h
    have huwne : u ≠ w := by intro e; subst w; exact hwx hux
    have hvxne : v ≠ x := by intro e; subst x; exact hwx hvw.symm
    apply hp
    exact ⟨x, u, v, w, hux.ne.symm, hvxne.symm, fun e => huw (e ▸ hux),
      huv.ne, huwne, hvw.ne, hux.symm, huv, hvw,
      fun h => hvx h.symm, fun h => hwx h.symm, huw⟩
  intro x
  exact ⟨one huv hvw, one hvw.symm huv.symm⟩

theorem completeBipartition_or_inducedP4 {V : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (hc : G.Connected) (ht : G.CliqueFree 3) :
    HasCompleteBipartition G ∨ ∃ a b c d, InducedP4 G a b c d := by
  classical
  by_cases hp : ∃ a b c d, InducedP4 G a b c d
  · exact Or.inr hp
  left
  obtain ⟨v⟩ := hc.nonempty
  have classify : ∀ x, G.Adj v x ∨ ∀ z, G.Adj v z ↔ G.Adj x z := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨p⟩ := hc.preconnected v x
    have walkprop : ∀ {y x : V}, G.Walk y x →
        (G.Adj v y ∨ ∀ z, G.Adj v z ↔ G.Adj y z) →
        (G.Adj v x ∨ ∀ z, G.Adj v z ↔ G.Adj x z) := by
      intro y x p
      induction p with
      | nil => exact id
      | @cons y z x hyz p ih =>
        intro h
        apply ih
        rcases h with h | h
        · exact Or.inr (two_step_twins G ht hp h hyz)
        · exact Or.inl ((h z).mpr hyz)
    exact walkprop p (Or.inr (fun _ => Iff.rfl))
  refine ⟨{x | G.Adj v x}, ?_⟩
  intro x y
  change G.Adj x y ↔ (G.Adj v x ∧ ¬ G.Adj v y) ∨ (¬ G.Adj v x ∧ G.Adj v y)
  have twins : ∀ x, ¬ G.Adj v x → ∀ z, G.Adj v z ↔ G.Adj x z := by
    intro x hx
    exact (classify x).resolve_left hx
  constructor
  · intro hxy
    by_cases hx : G.Adj v x
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hx, fun hy => no_triangle G ht hx hy hxy⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hx, (twins x hx y).mpr hxy⟩
  · rintro (⟨hx, hy⟩ | ⟨hx, hy⟩)
    · exact ((twins y hy x).mp hx).symm
    · exact (twins x hx y).mp hy

theorem inducedP4_of_not_completeBipartition {V : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (hc : G.Connected) (ht : G.CliqueFree 3) (hb : ¬ HasCompleteBipartition G) :
    ∃ a b c d, InducedP4 G a b c d :=
  (completeBipartition_or_inducedP4 G hc ht).resolve_left hb

end Sigma365710
